exactSourceStatements: Our solar system includes the Sun, eight planets, five officially named dwarf planets
The hottest planet in our solar system is Venus, even though Mercury is closer to the Sun.
Our solar system formed about 4.6 billion years ago from a dense cloud of interstellar gas and dust.
